facts.fact: 预展派对开场：姐妹俩当众相对惊愕、说不出话，随即彼此抓紧对方的手、指节发白；Dolly 叫了一声，一名摄影师凑近拍下这一幕。
facts.anchor: they grip each other’s hands, knuckles whitening

facts.fact: Mimi 走上透明讲台致辞，宣布「欢迎来看我这场干得漂亮的彻底清理——是时候了」，全场笑声。
facts.anchor: ‘And welcome to my damn good clear-out. It was time!’

facts.fact: Mimi 披露哥哥 Alf 与亡夫的姊妹 Nancy 都死于 1969 年夏天；拍卖收益捐给 RSPB（以爱鸟的 Alf 为念），庄园拍卖所得捐给以 Nancy 命名、资助年轻女性的艺术基金会。
facts.anchor: Alf, my brother, died that summer. As did Nancy, my late husband’s sister.

facts.fact: Mimi 当众介绍压轴来宾：亲姐姐 Pamela（就是那位 Pamela Mackie），承认姐妹已疏远多年，并请全场举杯敬「 Plantswoman and grandmother extraordinaire」。
facts.anchor: Finally, my big sister, Pamela. Yes, that is the Pamela Mackie.

facts.fact: Granny 占住话筒致辞，先谈「姐妹心有灵犀是胡说」，再当众暗示 Mimi 尚有未说出的真相：我们不知道自己不知道什么。
facts.anchor: But we don’t know what we don’t know. She may be the exception in many ways, but she’s not the exception to that.

facts.fact: Granny 当众归还那颗「失踪的海玻璃心」——Mimi 与 Lawrence 在 Lyme Regis 捡到的那颗——并说它属于这场拍卖。
facts.anchor: I’m returning the missing sea-glass heart you and Lawrence found in Lyme Regis, Miriam. It belongs in your auction.

facts.fact: Granny 坦白海玻璃心是自己「很久很久以前某个夏日」偷的，但动机刚说到 because 就被切断，本章未揭。
facts.anchor: I stole it one summer’s day, long, long ago because –

facts.fact: Granny 把一页折好的信塞进 Mimi 手里；Woody 把她拨到自己身后、对话筒说「That’s all, folks」，Granny 挤过惊呆的人群离场，Mimi 高举信喊她，Jo 成了 collateral damage。
facts.anchor: Granny thrusts a folded bit of paper into Mimi’s hands just before Woody pushes her behind him
